title: Auditing Path-Specific Fairness Across Causal Discovery Algorithms: A Heart Failure Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2603.15926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly applied to healthcare data, where the recovered relationships can encode biased pathways that propagate to downstream prediction. Path-specific fairness analysis, through direct, indirect, and spurious effect decompositions along with fairness-utility ratio assessment allows bias quantification and associated prediction cost. However, existing evaluations of causal discovery under fairness constraints have largely used non-clinical datasets and have not separated the contribution of confounders from that of mediators, leaving open how discovery-algorithm choice propagates through path-specific fairness to the utility trade-off in clinical settings. This work addresses that gap by establishing an expert-elicited causal graph benchmark for the heart failure clinical records dataset and tracing discovery algorithms through composite, per-variable fairness decompositions and fairness-utility ratio.

translated_title: 审计因果发现算法中的路径特定公平性：一项心力衰竭案例研究
translated_abstract: 因果发现方法正越来越多地应用于医疗健康数据，而从中恢复出的因果关系可能编码了带有偏见的路径，并传播到下游预测之中。路径特定公平性分析通过对直接效应、间接效应和虚假效应进行分解，并结合公平性-效用比率的评估，能够量化偏差及其相关的预测代价。然而，现有的在公平性约束下对因果发现的评估大多使用非临床数据集，并且未能将混杂因素的贡献与中介因素的贡献区分开来，这使得因果发现算法的选择如何通过路径特定公平性传导至临床场景中的效用权衡这一问题仍然悬而未决。本工作通过为心力衰竭临床记录数据集建立一个由专家引出的因果图基准，并通过复合的、逐变量的公平性分解以及公平性-效用比率来追踪评估各类因果发现算法，从而填补了这一空白。
tldr: 本研究通过为心力衰竭临床记录数据集建立专家引导的因果图基准，首次在临床数据上系统评估了不同因果发现算法的选择如何通过路径特定公平性分解传导并影响公平性与效用的权衡。
en_tdlr: This study establishes an expert-elicited causal graph benchmark for the heart failure clinical records dataset, providing the first clinical-data audit of how the choice of causal discovery algorithm propagates through path-specific fairness decompositions to the fairness-utility trade-off.
